$comment: MSI Surfaces (www.msisurfaces.com) runs on ASP.NET Core (Kestrel; AutoFill.asmx web services) with a custom Bootstrap 3 storefront theme. MSI sells through dealers, so the product page carries no price at all: there is no price element, no cart button and no price in JSON-LD (only a BreadcrumbList), just 'Check Inventory' and 'Dealer Locator' links, so price is not configured and every product returns price.state 'unknown' with a PRICE_MISSING warning (price_unit usd only keeps currency USD in the response). There is no availability signal either: the only stock widget, div#divRealTimeInventory, is never rendered server-side, so availability is not configured. Product URLs are /{category}/{collection}/{color}/ and the color segment may contain spaces (for example /luxury-vinyl-planks/ashton-2/benton blonde/), hence the space in the match character class. Specs are not a table: pairs of div.col-xs-6 blocks inside div.specs-column, each with div.specs-heading (name) and div.specs-label (value), plus one div.application-info block holding the Flooring/Residential/Commercial applications; the 'Additional Resources' row only holds a disclaimer link and is dropped with specs.exclude. The description is the bullet list in div.product-highlights; the main image is the desktop gallery image (img#detail_image, CDN). Checked against a saved (curl) Briven Luxury Vinyl Plank page on 2026-11-12.
